title: Chinese beef and broccoli skillet
steps: Start the rice and stir soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, cornflour and water together.
Sear the thinly sliced steak in batches until browned; transfer it out.
Cook broccoli, garlic and ginger with a splash of water until tender.
Return the protein, add sauce, toss until glossy, and serve over rice.

title: Chinese beef chow mein with capsicum
steps: Soak or boil noodles until barely tender and drain. Mix soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sesame oil and water.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced steak until cooked, then transfer it out.
Stir-fry cabbage, carrot, capsicum, garlic and ginger until tender.
Return protein, add noodles and sauce, and toss until steaming.

title: Chinese beef and green beans with rice
steps: Start the rice. Char green beans in a hot pan with half the oil until blistered; transfer them out.
Cook the thinly sliced steak with garlic and ginger in remaining oil until browned and cooked.
Add dark soy, Shaoxing wine, sugar and chilli; toss to coat.
Return beans and serve over rice.

title: Chinese beef rice noodles with broccoli
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar and water.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced rump steak until browned and cooked; transfer it out.
Stir-fry broccoli, capsicum, garlic and ginger.
Return protein, add noodles and sauce, toss until absorbed, and serve.

title: Chinese chicken and broccoli skillet
steps: Start the rice and stir soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, cornflour and water together.
Sear the thinly sliced chicken thighs in batches until browned; transfer it out.
Cook broccoli, garlic and ginger with a splash of water until tender.
Return the protein, add sauce, toss until glossy, and serve over rice.

title: Chinese chicken chow mein with cabbage
steps: Soak or boil noodles until barely tender and drain. Mix soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sesame oil and water.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced chicken thighs until cooked, then transfer it out.
Stir-fry cabbage, carrot, capsicum, garlic and ginger until tender.
Return protein, add noodles and sauce, and toss until steaming.

title: Chinese chicken rice noodles with broccoli
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar and water.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced chicken thighs until browned and cooked; transfer it out.
Stir-fry broccoli, capsicum, garlic and ginger.
Return protein, add noodles and sauce, toss until absorbed, and serve.

title: Chinese crispy sesame chicken with broccoli
steps: Start the rice. Pat the protein dry and coat it with cornflour.
Pan-fry the bite-size chicken thighs in oil until crisp and cooked through.
Mix soy, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, cornflour and water; bubble until glossy.
Toss through sesame seeds and serve with broccoli and rice.

title: Chinese crispy sesame tofu with broccoli
steps: Start the rice. Pat the protein dry and coat it with cornflour.
Pan-fry the firm tofu in oil until crisp and cooked through.
Mix soy, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, cornflour and water; bubble until glossy.
Toss through sesame seeds and serve with broccoli and rice.

title: Ginger chicken with broccoli and rice
steps: Cook rice in the rice cooker. Slice chicken thinly, broccoli into small florets and carrot into thin half-moons.
Heat oil in a wok. Stir-fry chicken for 5–7 minutes until cooked through; transfer to a plate.
Stir-fry vegetables with a splash of water for 4–5 minutes. Add minced ginger and garlic for 30 seconds.
Return chicken, add soy and oyster sauces, and toss for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

title: Chinese kung pao chicken with peanuts
steps: Start the rice and mix soy, vinegar, sugar, oyster sauce, cornflour and water.
Cook the bite-size chicken thighs in hot oil until browned; remove it.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, chilli and capsicum until fragrant.
Return protein, add peanuts and sauce, toss until bubbling, and serve over rice.

title: Chinese kung pao tofu with peanuts
steps: Start the rice and mix soy, vinegar, sugar, oyster sauce, cornflour and water.
Cook the firm tofu in hot oil until browned; remove it.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, chilli and capsicum until fragrant.
Return protein, add peanuts and sauce, toss until bubbling, and serve over rice.

title: Chinese mapo tofu with beef mince
steps: Start the rice. Mix gochujang, gochugaru, soy, stock and cornflour.
Cook the beef mince with garlic, ginger and onion until browned.
Add sauce and simmer; fold in tofu gently for 3–4 minutes.
Stir in sesame oil and spring onion. Serve over rice.

title: Chinese mapo tofu with pork mince
steps: Start the rice. Mix gochujang, gochugaru, soy, stock and cornflour.
Cook the pork mince with garlic, ginger and onion until browned.
Add sauce and simmer; fold in tofu gently for 3–4 minutes.
Stir in sesame oil and spring onion. Serve over rice.

title: Chinese moo goo gai pan chicken
steps: Start the rice. Slice chicken, mushrooms, broccoli and carrot.
Mix soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, cornflour and water.
Stir-fry chicken in oil, then add mushrooms, broccoli, carrot, garlic and ginger until tender-crisp.
Add sauce and toss until thickened. Serve with rice.

title: Pork and cabbage stir-fry
steps: Start the rice. Thinly shred cabbage and slice carrot.
Brown pork in oil for 5–6 minutes, breaking it apart.
Add carrot and cabbage; stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until tender. Add minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in soy sauce and vinegar. Cook for another minute and serve with rice.

title: Chinese pork chow mein with mushrooms
steps: Soak or boil noodles until barely tender and drain. Mix soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sesame oil and water.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced pork loin until cooked, then transfer it out.
Stir-fry cabbage, carrot, capsicum, garlic and ginger until tender.
Return protein, add noodles and sauce, and toss until steaming.

title: Chinese pork and green beans with rice
steps: Start the rice. Char green beans in a hot pan with half the oil until blistered; transfer them out.
Cook the pork mince with garlic and ginger in remaining oil until browned and cooked.
Add dark soy, Shaoxing wine, sugar and chilli; toss to coat.
Return beans and serve over rice.

title: Chinese pork rice noodles with mushrooms
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar and water.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced pork loin until browned and cooked; transfer it out.
Stir-fry broccoli, capsicum, garlic and ginger.
Return protein, add noodles and sauce, toss until absorbed, and serve.

title: Chinese pressure-cooker shredded chicken with bok choy
steps: Put chicken, soy, oyster sauce, ginger, garlic and water in the pressure cooker.
Cook on high pressure for 10 minutes, allow 5 minutes natural release, then release the rest.
Shred chicken in its liquid and taste for seasoning.
Serve with rice and steamed bok choy.

title: Chinese tofu and broccoli skillet
steps: Start the rice and stir soy, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sugar, cornflour and water together.
Sear the firm tofu in batches until browned; transfer it out.
Cook broccoli, garlic and ginger with a splash of water until tender.
Return the protein, add sauce, toss until glossy, and serve over rice.

title: Chinese tofu and green beans with rice
steps: Start the rice. Char green beans in a hot pan with half the oil until blistered; transfer them out.
Cook the firm tofu with garlic and ginger in remaining oil until browned and cooked.
Add dark soy, Shaoxing wine, sugar and chilli; toss to coat.
Return beans and serve over rice.

title: Soy-braised tofu and mushrooms
steps: Start rice. Pat tofu dry and cube; slice mushrooms and bok choy.
Pan-fry tofu in oil for 6–8 minutes, turning gently.
Add mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes. Add minced garlic and ginger, then soy, sugar and 100 ml water.
Simmer for 4 minutes. Add bok choy and cook for 3 minutes until tender. Serve with rice.

notes: Adapted from Sarah Leung, The Woks of Life. Black pepper and brown sugar replace white pepper and white sugar; reduced salt/sugar. About 35 minutes total including rice. Not yet household-tested.
title: Chinese tomato and egg stir-fry with rice
steps: Put rice and 300 ml water in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low and cook for 12–15 minutes until absorbed; rest covered off heat for 10 minutes. Check the rice packet and adjust the measured water if its instructions differ.
Meanwhile, prepare tomatoes and spring onion. Beat eggs with ¼ tsp salt, pepper, sesame oil and wine.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Scramble eggs into soft curds, then transfer to a bowl.
Add remaining oil, tomatoes and all spring onion. Stir for 1 minute. Add sugar, remaining salt and 60 ml water; cover and simmer for 2–4 minutes until tomatoes and onion soften.
Fold eggs back in. Cook uncovered until eggs are fully set and sauce lightly coats them; leave enough juices for the rice. Divide rice and stir-fry between two bowls.

title: Japanese beef chinjao rosu with bamboo shoots
steps: Start the rice. Mix the protein with soy, sake and cornflour; mix the sauce separately.
Stir-fry capsicum and bamboo shoots until tender, then transfer out.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced rump steak in remaining oil until browned and nearly cooked.
Return vegetables, add sauce, toss until thickened, and serve with rice.

title: Teriyaki-style chicken rice bowls
steps: Start rice. Cut chicken into small pieces and vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Steam broccoli and carrot until tender, about 6–8 minutes.
Fry chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes until cooked through.
Add soy, honey, vinegar and 2 tbsp water. Simmer for 2 minutes to glaze. Serve with vegetables and rice.

title: Japanese chicken teriyaki with broccoli
steps: Start the rice in the rice cooker.
Pat the boneless chicken thighs dry and cut it into even pieces. Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar.
Sear the boneless chicken thighs in oil until browned and cooked through.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until glossy. Serve with the cooked vegetables and rice.

title: Japanese chicken and tofu hot pot with cabbage
steps: Start rice. Bring water, ginger, soy and sesame oil to a simmer in a wide saucepan.
Add cabbage and mushrooms and cook 2 minutes.
Arrange the boneless chicken thighs and tofu over the vegetables, cover and simmer until cooked through.
Taste broth, add spring onion, and serve with rice.

title: Japanese pork and tofu hot pot with cabbage
steps: Start rice. Bring water, ginger, soy and sesame oil to a simmer in a wide saucepan.
Add cabbage and mushrooms and cook 2 minutes.
Arrange the pork loin and tofu over the vegetables, cover and simmer until cooked through.
Taste broth, add spring onion, and serve with rice.

title: Japanese miso ginger chicken with broccoli
steps: Start the rice. Mix ginger, sake and soy sauce, coat the protein and rest briefly.
Sear the boneless chicken thighs in oil until just cooked through.
Whisk miso, soy, sake, mirin, sugar and water; pour into the pan and turn the protein until thickened.
Serve with cooked vegetables and rice.

title: Japanese miso ginger pork with cabbage
steps: Start the rice. Mix ginger, sake and soy sauce, coat the protein and rest briefly.
Sear the pork loin in oil until just cooked through.
Whisk miso, soy, sake, mirin, sugar and water; pour into the pan and turn the protein until thickened.
Serve with cooked vegetables and rice.

title: Japanese niku miso chicken with cabbage
steps: Start the rice and cook the vegetables until tender.
Stir miso, soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, cornflour and water until smooth.
Cook the boneless chicken thighs with ginger and spring onion in sesame oil until browned and cooked through.
Add sauce and simmer until it clings. Serve over rice.

title: Japanese niku miso pork rice bowls
steps: Start the rice and cook the vegetables until tender.
Stir miso, soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, cornflour and water until smooth.
Cook the pork mince with ginger and spring onion in sesame oil until browned and cooked through.
Add sauce and simmer until it clings. Serve over rice.

title: Japanese niku miso tofu with mushrooms
steps: Start the rice and cook the vegetables until tender.
Stir miso, soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, cornflour and water until smooth.
Cook the firm tofu with ginger and spring onion in sesame oil until browned and cooked through.
Add sauce and simmer until it clings. Serve over rice.

title: Japanese pork chinjao rosu with capsicum
steps: Start the rice. Mix the protein with soy, sake and cornflour; mix the sauce separately.
Stir-fry capsicum and bamboo shoots until tender, then transfer out.
Stir-fry the thinly sliced pork loin in remaining oil until browned and nearly cooked.
Return vegetables, add sauce, toss until thickened, and serve with rice.

title: Japanese pork and cabbage gyoza
steps: Mix pork, cabbage, mushrooms, spring onion, ginger, garlic, soy and sesame oil.
Place about 1 tbsp filling in each wrapper, fold and press closed; make about 20.
Pan-fry dumplings in oil until bottoms are golden, add water, cover and steam 5–6 minutes.
Uncover and cook until dry; serve with soy and vinegar.

title: Japanese salmon teriyaki with bok choy
steps: Start the rice in the rice cooker.
Pat the salmon fillets dry and cut it into even pieces. Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar.
Sear the salmon fillets in oil until browned and cooked through.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until glossy. Serve with the cooked vegetables and rice.

title: Japanese tofu teriyaki with capsicum
steps: Start the rice in the rice cooker.
Pat the firm tofu dry and cut it into even pieces. Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar.
Sear the firm tofu in oil until browned and cooked through.
Pour in the sauce and simmer until glossy. Serve with the cooked vegetables and rice.

title: Korean beef bulgogi skillet with mushrooms
steps: Mix soy, sugar, sesame oil, ginger, garlic and pepper; coat the protein and rest 20–30 minutes.
Cook the beef rump steak in batches in a very hot pan so the edges caramelise.
Add onion and mushrooms and cook until tender.
Serve with rice and blanched bok choy; these replace raw wrap accompaniments.

title: Korean beef doenjang stew with zucchini
steps: Start rice. Heat oil and cook the beef rump steak with garlic until browned.
Add water, doenjang and gochugaru and bring to a simmer.
Add potato, onion, zucchini and tofu; cover and cook about 12 minutes.
Taste, add spring onion, and serve with rice.

title: Korean beef sundubu stew with egg
steps: Mix gochugaru, sesame oil and pepper. Start rice.
Cook the beef rump steak with onion and garlic in oil until no longer pink.
Add water, fish sauce and the spicy seasoning; simmer 5 minutes.
Add tofu, cook 3–4 minutes, crack in eggs and cover until set. Serve with rice.

title: Korean chicken doenjang stew with zucchini
steps: Start rice. Heat oil and cook the boneless chicken thighs with garlic until browned.
Add water, doenjang and gochugaru and bring to a simmer.
Add potato, onion, zucchini and tofu; cover and cook about 12 minutes.
Taste, add spring onion, and serve with rice.

title: Korean garlic fried chicken with rice
steps: Toss chicken with ginger, soy, pepper and cornflour.
Shallow-fry chicken in batches until crisp, golden and cooked through.
Stir-fry garlic, chilli and spring onion in the same pan.
Add soy, vinegar, sugar and water; bubble briefly, return chicken, toss, and serve with rice.

title: Korean gochujang beef rice bowls
steps: Start rice. Stir gochujang, soy, honey, sesame oil and water together.
Cook the beef rump steak in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add garlic, ginger, capsicum and broccoli and stir-fry until tender.
Add sauce and toss until sticky; serve over rice with sesame seeds.

title: Korean gochujang chicken rice bowls
steps: Start rice. Stir gochujang, soy, honey, sesame oil and water together.
Cook the boneless chicken thighs in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add garlic, ginger, capsicum and broccoli and stir-fry until tender.
Add sauce and toss until sticky; serve over rice with sesame seeds.

title: Gochujang pork and cabbage bowls
steps: Start rice. Shred cabbage and slice carrot finely.
Brown pork in oil for 5–6 minutes.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 6–8 minutes until tender.
Stir in gochujang, soy, sugar and 2 tbsp water. Cook for 2 minutes; finish with sesame oil and serve with rice.

title: Korean pork bulgogi skillet with mushrooms
steps: Mix soy, sugar, sesame oil, ginger, garlic and pepper; coat the protein and rest 20–30 minutes.
Cook the pork loin in batches in a very hot pan so the edges caramelise.
Add onion and mushrooms and cook until tender.
Serve with rice and blanched bok choy; these replace raw wrap accompaniments.

title: Korean pork sundubu stew with egg
steps: Mix gochugaru, sesame oil and pepper. Start rice.
Cook the pork mince with onion and garlic in oil until no longer pink.
Add water, fish sauce and the spicy seasoning; simmer 5 minutes.
Add tofu, cook 3–4 minutes, crack in eggs and cover until set. Serve with rice.

title: Korean spicy chicken stir-fry with cabbage
steps: Mix gochujang, gochugaru, soy, sugar, sesame oil, ginger and garlic; coat the protein and rest 20 minutes.
Cook the boneless chicken thighs with onion in a very hot pan until deeply coloured and cooked through.
Add cabbage and a splash of water and toss until softened and sticky.
Serve with rice and cooked vegetables.

title: Korean spicy pork stew with tofu and potato
steps: Mix gochujang, gochugaru, sesame oil, ginger, garlic and pepper.
Put onion, potato and pork mince in a saucepan and toss with the paste.
Add water and fish sauce, cover and simmer 20–25 minutes until tender.
Fold in tofu and spring onion for the final 3 minutes; serve with rice.

title: Korean spicy pork stir-fry with cabbage
steps: Mix gochujang, gochugaru, soy, sugar, sesame oil, ginger and garlic; coat the protein and rest 20 minutes.
Cook the pork loin with onion in a very hot pan until deeply coloured and cooked through.
Add cabbage and a splash of water and toss until softened and sticky.
Serve with rice and cooked vegetables.

title: Korean sweet-and-crunchy tofu with broccoli
steps: Start rice. Pat tofu dry and coat it with cornflour.
Pan-fry tofu in oil until golden and crisp.
Simmer gochujang, ketchup, honey and vinegar for 1–2 minutes.
Turn tofu through the sauce and serve with broccoli and rice.

title: Korean-style mapadubu with tofu and vegetables
steps: Start rice. Stir gochujang, gochugaru, soy, stock and cornflour together.
Cook the firm tofu with garlic, ginger and onion until browned.
Add sauce and simmer; fold in tofu gently for 3–4 minutes.
Stir in sesame oil and spring onion and serve over rice.

title: Malaysian-inspired coconut chicken curry
steps: Start rice. Slice chicken, onion and carrot; trim beans.
Fry onion and chicken in oil for 5 minutes. Add minced garlic and curry powder for 30 seconds.
Add coconut milk and carrot. Simmer for 8 minutes.
Add beans and simmer for 5 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender. Serve with rice.

title: Portuguese-inspired peri-peri chicken and rice
steps: Mix paprika, cumin, chilli, garlic, salt and oil and coat the chicken.
Sear chicken in a wide lidded pan until browned; remove it.
Cook rice with onion, capsicum, tomato paste and stock. Nestle chicken on top, cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Rest covered 5 minutes, fluff, and serve.

title: Singapore chicken rice noodles
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix soy, Shaoxing wine, curry powder, sugar and pepper.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and transfer out.
Stir-fry the boneless chicken thighs until cooked, then add onion, capsicum and garlic.
Add noodles, peas and sauce; toss until hot and fold through egg.

title: Singapore pork rice noodles
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix soy, Shaoxing wine, curry powder, sugar and pepper.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and transfer out.
Stir-fry the pork loin until cooked, then add onion, capsicum and garlic.
Add noodles, peas and sauce; toss until hot and fold through egg.

title: Singapore tofu rice noodles
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix soy, Shaoxing wine, curry powder, sugar and pepper.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and transfer out.
Stir-fry the firm tofu until cooked, then add onion, capsicum and garlic.
Add noodles, peas and sauce; toss until hot and fold through egg.

notes: Requires cooked rice prepared and chilled ahead; the active time excludes that earlier preparation.
title: Spam egg fried rice
steps: Dice the Spam, slice spring onions and keep the white and green parts separate.
Use cooked rice made from 180 g dry rice, prepared ahead and chilled. Break up any clumps.
Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Add 1 tbsp oil, then scramble the eggs until about 80% cooked. Transfer to a plate.
Add the Spam to the dry pan and fry until browned and lightly crisp at the edges. If it releases a lot of fat, carefully remove any excess.
Add the spring-onion whites and frozen peas. Stir-fry for 1–2 minutes.
Increase the heat to high, add the rice, and stir-fry vigorously for 3–5 minutes until hot and the grains are separate.
Add the soy sauce, kecap manis, and a few grinds of pepper. Toss well.
Return the eggs, add the spring-onion greens and, if using, sesame oil. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes until the greens are cooked, then serve.

notes: Hand-cut skin-on pork belly and fried shallots give this Taiwanese-style braise its characteristic rich, glossy sauce. Total elapsed time is about 1 hour 45 minutes, mostly unattended.
title: Taiwanese lu rou fan (braised pork rice)
steps: Put the dried shiitake in a bowl with 250 ml of the boiling water; cover and soak for 20 minutes. Lift them out, squeeze gently, remove the tough stems, and slice the caps into 5 mm strips. Strain and reserve the soaking liquid, leaving any grit behind. Meanwhile, toss the chilled pork belly with 1 tsp of the Shaoxing wine and 1/2 tsp of the dark soy sauce.

Start the rice in the rice cooker according to its instructions. Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool under cold running water, and peel. Halve the bok choy lengthways; blanch it in the egg water for 1–2 minutes until tender, then drain.

Put the pork and its marinade in a dry, small heavy-based saucepan over medium heat. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring, until some fat renders and the edges are lightly browned. Stir in the garlic for 20 seconds.

Add the remaining 3 tsp Shaoxing wine, remaining 1 1/2 tsp dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, rock sugar, star anise, cinnamon, fried shallots, and shiitake. Stir for 30 seconds, then add the reserved mushroom liquid. Add up to the remaining 100 ml boiling water as needed so the pork is just covered.

Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a very gentle simmer and partially cover. Braise for 60–75 minutes, stirring every 20 minutes. Add the peeled eggs for the final 30 minutes, turning once. The pork is ready when the skin and fat are yielding and the meat is tender; add a splash of hot water if the pan threatens to dry out before then.

Remove the eggs and whole spices. If the sauce is watery, simmer uncovered for 5–10 minutes until glossy and loose enough to soak into rice; if it becomes sticky, loosen it with hot water. Taste before adding any salt. Halve the eggs and spoon the pork, sauce, and egg over the rice with the blanched bok choy.

title: Thai basil chicken with green beans
steps: Thinly slice chicken and capsicum. Trim and halve beans and mince garlic.
Start the measured dry rice in the rice cooker according to its instructions.
Mix oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, and chilli (if using) with 2 tbsp water.
Heat a large frying pan or wok until very hot. Add oil, then chicken; stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add garlic, beans, and capsicum. Stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, keeping the vegetables bright and tender-crisp.
Add the sauce and toss for about 1 minute until it lightly coats the chicken. Turn off the heat, fold through basil, and serve with rice.

title: Thai beef pad kra pao with fried egg
steps: Start rice and mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, dark soy, sugar and water.
Stir-fry garlic and chilli in hot oil, then add the beef mince and cook until browned.
Add onion and capsicum and toss until tender; add sauce and reduce briefly.
Turn off heat, fold through basil until wilted, and serve with rice and fried eggs if using.

title: Thai-inspired chicken and vegetable noodles
steps: Cook noodles following the packet and drain.
Thinly slice chicken and vegetables. Stir-fry chicken in oil for 5–7 minutes until cooked through.
Add vegetables and cook for 4 minutes; add minced garlic.
Toss in noodles, sauces, sugar and chilli with a splash of water. Cook for 2 minutes.

title: Thai chicken pad see ew with broccoli
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, dark soy and sugar.
Stir-fry the boneless chicken thighs until cooked and transfer it out.
Add oil, garlic and egg; scramble, then add broccoli and cook until tender-crisp.
Add noodles and sauce and toss over high heat; return protein and serve.

title: Thai drunken beef rice noodles
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, sugar, vinegar and water.
Stir-fry the beef mince until cooked and transfer it out.
Stir-fry garlic, chilli, capsicum and broccoli until fragrant.
Add noodles and sauce, toss until glossy, return protein, and fold through basil.

title: Thai drunken tofu rice noodles
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, sugar, vinegar and water.
Stir-fry the firm tofu until cooked and transfer it out.
Stir-fry garlic, chilli, capsicum and broccoli until fragrant.
Add noodles and sauce, toss until glossy, return protein, and fold through basil.

title: Thai green curry chicken with eggplant
steps: Start rice. Reduce half the coconut milk in a saucepan, then fry green curry paste in it for 1 minute.
Add the boneless chicken thighs and coat it; pour in remaining coconut milk and water.
Add eggplant, capsicum and beans and simmer until tender.
Season with fish sauce and sugar, fold through basil, and serve over rice.

title: Thai green curry tofu with eggplant
steps: Start rice. Reduce half the coconut milk in a saucepan, then fry green curry paste in it for 1 minute.
Add the firm tofu and coat it; pour in remaining coconut milk and water.
Add eggplant, capsicum and beans and simmer until tender.
Season with fish sauce and sugar, fold through basil, and serve over rice.

title: Thai pork pad kra pao with fried egg
steps: Start rice and mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, dark soy, sugar and water.
Stir-fry garlic and chilli in hot oil, then add the pork mince and cook until browned.
Add onion and capsicum and toss until tender; add sauce and reduce briefly.
Turn off heat, fold through basil until wilted, and serve with rice and fried eggs if using.

title: Thai pork pad see ew with broccoli
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, dark soy and sugar.
Stir-fry the pork loin until cooked and transfer it out.
Add oil, garlic and egg; scramble, then add broccoli and cook until tender-crisp.
Add noodles and sauce and toss over high heat; return protein and serve.

title: Thai red curry pork with carrots and capsicum
steps: Thinly slice carrots and capsicum and mince garlic.
Start the measured dry rice in the rice cooker according to its instructions.
Heat oil in a wide pan. Cook pork mince for 4–5 minutes, breaking it up until browned.
Add garlic and curry paste; fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, carrots, capsicum, sugar, and fish sauce. Simmer for 10–12 minutes until the carrots are tender and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust with more fish sauce or sugar if needed. Serve with rice.

title: Thai rice noodles with chicken (guay tiew kua gai)
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix soy, dark soy, sugar, oyster sauce and water.
Sear chicken in a hot wok until browned and almost cooked; transfer it out.
Scramble egg with garlic, add noodles and sauce, and toss until absorbed.
Return chicken, add broccoli, toss until tender, and serve hot.

title: Thai tofu pad kra pao with basil
steps: Start rice and mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, dark soy, sugar and water.
Stir-fry garlic and chilli in hot oil, then add the firm tofu and cook until browned.
Add onion and capsicum and toss until tender; add sauce and reduce briefly.
Turn off heat, fold through basil until wilted, and serve with rice and fried eggs if using.

title: Thai tofu pad see ew with broccoli
steps: Soak rice noodles until pliable and drain. Mix oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce, dark soy and sugar.
Stir-fry the firm tofu until cooked and transfer it out.
Add oil, garlic and egg; scramble, then add broccoli and cook until tender-crisp.
Add noodles and sauce and toss over high heat; return protein and serve.

title: Thai red curry tofu and broccoli
steps: Start rice and cut tofu into cubes and vegetables into small pieces.
Fry curry paste in oil for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, carrot and tofu. Simmer for 8 minutes.
Add broccoli and soy sauce; simmer for 5 minutes until vegetables are tender. Serve with rice. Choose a vegetarian curry paste if needed.

title: Vietnamese caramelised beef bowls
steps: Start rice. Cook onion, ginger and garlic in oil until fragrant.
Sprinkle in sugar and let it melt to amber. Add the beef mince and stir until browned.
Add fish sauce, soy and water and simmer until glossy and cooked through.
Add beans and carrot for the final few minutes and serve over rice.

title: Vietnamese caramel chicken with green beans
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces, trim beans and mince garlic.
Start the measured dry rice in the rice cooker according to its instructions.
Mix fish sauce, soy sauce, water, and plenty of black pepper. Heat oil in a wide frying pan and cook chicken for 5–6 minutes until browned.
Push chicken aside. Add brown sugar to the bare part of the pan; let it melt and turn deep amber for 30–60 seconds, then carefully stir in the sauce mixture.
Add garlic and green beans. Toss and simmer for 5–6 minutes until the chicken is cooked, beans are tender-crisp, and the sauce coats everything. Serve with rice.

title: Vietnamese caramelised pork bowls
steps: Start rice. Cook onion, ginger and garlic in oil until fragrant.
Sprinkle in sugar and let it melt to amber. Add the pork mince and stir until browned.
Add fish sauce, soy and water and simmer until glossy and cooked through.
Add beans and carrot for the final few minutes and serve over rice.

title: Vietnamese caramelised tofu bowls
steps: Start rice. Cook onion, ginger and garlic in oil until fragrant.
Sprinkle in sugar and let it melt to amber. Add the firm tofu and stir until browned.
Add fish sauce, soy and water and simmer until glossy and cooked through.
Add beans and carrot for the final few minutes and serve over rice.

title: Caramel tofu with green beans and rice
steps: Start rice. Pat tofu dry, cube it and trim beans.
Pan-fry tofu in oil for 8 minutes, turning until golden.
Add beans with 3 tbsp water, cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic, soy, sugar and vinegar. Toss and simmer for 3 minutes until beans are tender and tofu is coated; serve with rice.

title: Baked eggs with potatoes, mushrooms and cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into 2 cm chunks and boil for 5 minutes. Drain well.
Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan. Fry the potatoes for 5 minutes, then add the sliced mushrooms and garlic and cook for 5–8 minutes until browned. Season with the salt, pepper and herbs.
Stir through half the cheese. Make four wells and crack in the eggs. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese.
Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft, then serve from the pan.

title: Quick beef cottage pie
steps: Peel and chunk the potatoes. Boil for 12–15 minutes until tender, drain, mash with the cream and season with half the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a frying pan. Cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes, then add the beef and brown for another 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce for 1 minute. Add the stock and simmer uncovered for 8–10 minutes until thickened. Stir in the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C. Spoon the filling into a small ovenproof dish, top with the mash and roughen the surface with a fork.
Bake for 15 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Beef fajitas with cooked capsicum and onion
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and wrap tortillas in foil to warm.
Mix paprika, cumin, garlic, oil and lime and coat the beef rump steak with capsicum and onion.
Cook everything in a very hot pan until the protein is done and vegetables are charred and tender.
Serve hot filling in warm tortillas; omit raw salsa or salad.

title: Beef meatballs with creamy mushrooms and mash
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender. Drain, mash with 30 ml of the cream and season with a pinch of salt, then keep warm.
Mix the beef, Parmesan, herbs, half the salt and half the pepper. Shape into 10–12 small meatballs.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wide frying pan. Brown the meatballs for 6–8 minutes, turning, until cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes until softened and browned.
Add the stock and remaining cream and simmer for 3 minutes. Return the meatballs and simmer for 2 minutes until hot. Boil the peas separately for 3 minutes, then serve with the mash.

title: American beef and potato hash
steps: Dice the potatoes into 1.5 cm pieces and boil for 8 minutes until nearly tender. Drain well.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Cook the onion for 3 minutes, add the beef and brown for 5–6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the potatoes and fry for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the edges are golden.
Stir in the tomatoes, cream, Worcestershire sauce and peas. Simmer for 4–5 minutes until the peas are hot and the sauce coats the hash.
Season with the salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Mexican beef taco pasta
steps: Cook onion and garlic in oil in a deep skillet until softened.
Add the beef mince, cumin, paprika and chilli and cook until browned.
Stir in tomatoes, corn, pasta and water. Cover and simmer, stirring often, until pasta is tender.
Fold through cheese, taste for seasoning, and serve hot.

title: Beef and zucchini tomato pasta
steps: Cook pasta according to the packet.
Finely chop onion and dice zucchini. Brown beef in oil for 5 minutes.
Add onion and zucchini for 5 minutes, then minced garlic and herbs.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until beef is cooked. Toss with pasta and finish with Parmesan.

title: Beef and vegetable tomato pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender and reserve some cooking water.
Cook onion, garlic, carrot, zucchini and mushrooms in oil until softened.
Add beef mince and tomatoes with herbs and simmer until saucy.
Toss in pasta and spinach, loosening with cooking water; finish with Parmesan.

title: Pork, potato and pea skillet
steps: Dice potatoes into 1.5 cm pieces and boil for 10–12 minutes until tender, then drain.
Chop onion. Brown pork and onion in oil for 6–8 minutes until pork is cooked.
Add potatoes and fry for 4 minutes.
Stir in peas, mustard and 3 tbsp water. Cover and cook for 3–4 minutes until peas are hot. Season and serve.

title: Cheesy broccoli pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven grill to high. Boil pasta, adding broccoli for the final 4 minutes; drain.
Heat cream, mustard, Parmesan, half the cheese and a splash of pasta water until smooth.
Fold pasta and broccoli through sauce and transfer to an ovenproof dish.
Top with remaining cheese and grill 3–4 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Cheesy broccoli tofu pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven grill to high. Boil pasta, adding broccoli for the final 4 minutes; drain.
Heat cream, mustard, Parmesan, half the cheese and a splash of pasta water until smooth.
Fold pasta and broccoli through sauce and transfer to an ovenproof dish.
Top with remaining cheese and grill 3–4 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Chicken Alfredo with peas
steps: Cook chicken in oil until browned and cooked through, then slice or shred it.
Boil pasta until just tender and reserve cooking water.
Simmer cream and Parmesan until smooth; add peas or spinach until warmed or wilted.
Toss in pasta and chicken, loosen with cooking water, and season with pepper.

title: Chicken fajitas with cooked capsicum and onion
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and wrap tortillas in foil to warm.
Mix paprika, cumin, garlic, oil and lime and coat the boneless chicken thighs with capsicum and onion.
Cook everything in a very hot pan until the protein is done and vegetables are charred and tender.
Serve hot filling in warm tortillas; omit raw salsa or salad.

title: Mediterranean chicken, red pepper and potato traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes, capsicum and onion into bite-sized pieces. Toss them and the chicken with the garlic, cumin, paprika, lemon zest and juice, oil, salt and pepper.
Spread everything in a roasting dish and roast for 35–40 minutes, turning the vegetables once, until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the tray from the oven and rest the chicken for 2 minutes.
Spoon the roasting juices over the chicken and potatoes and serve with the yoghurt.

title: Chicken, spinach and peanut coconut curry
steps: Start the rice. Cook onion, garlic, cumin and curry powder in oil until fragrant.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk, peanut butter and water and simmer until thick.
Fold in spinach and cook until wilted; add lemon or lime and taste.
Serve over rice with peanuts.

title: Mexican chicken taco pasta
steps: Cook onion and garlic in oil in a deep skillet until softened.
Add the boneless chicken thighs, cumin, paprika and chilli and cook until browned.
Stir in tomatoes, corn, pasta and water. Cover and simmer, stirring often, until pasta is tender.
Fold through cheese, taste for seasoning, and serve hot.

title: Chicken and vegetable tomato pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender and reserve some cooking water.
Cook onion, garlic, carrot, zucchini and mushrooms in oil until softened.
Add boneless chicken thighs and tomatoes with herbs and simmer until saucy.
Toss in pasta and spinach, loosening with cooking water; finish with Parmesan.

title: Chickpea, spinach and peanut butter rice bowl
steps: Start the rice. Cook onion, garlic, cumin and curry powder in oil until fragrant.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk, peanut butter and water and simmer until thick.
Fold in spinach and cook until wilted; add lemon or lime and taste.
Serve over rice with peanuts.

title: Chickpea, spinach and peanut coconut curry
steps: Start the rice. Cook onion, garlic, cumin and curry powder in oil until fragrant.
Add chickpeas, coconut milk, peanut butter and water and simmer until thick.
Fold in spinach and cook until wilted; add lemon or lime and taste.
Serve over rice with peanuts.

title: Mexican chickpea taco pasta
steps: Cook onion and garlic in oil in a deep skillet until softened.
Add the chickpeas, cumin, paprika and chilli and cook until browned.
Stir in tomatoes, corn, pasta and water. Cover and simmer, stirring often, until pasta is tender.
Fold through cheese, taste for seasoning, and serve hot.

title: Smoky chickpea and zucchini skillet
steps: Start rice. Dice zucchini and capsicum and drain chickpeas.
Fry vegetables in oil for 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and paprika for 30 seconds. Stir in tomatoes and chickpeas.
Simmer for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender. Serve with rice.

title: Creamy garlic chicken, broccoli and mushroom pasta
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and broccoli into small florets. Slice mushrooms and mince garlic.
Boil pasta in well-salted water. Add broccoli for the final 3 minutes, then reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a large frying pan. Season chicken and cook for 5–6 minutes until browned and cooked through. Move it to a plate.
Add mushrooms to the pan and cook for 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add cream, Parmesan, chicken, pasta, and broccoli. Toss for 1–2 minutes, loosening with a little reserved pasta water. Season to taste.

title: Creamy mushroom and spinach pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender and reserve cooking water.
Cook mushrooms and garlic in oil until browned, then add cream and simmer briefly.
Stir in spinach, Parmesan, chilli and pepper.
Toss through pasta, loosening with cooking water, and serve.

title: Creamy salmon with potatoes and peas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into thin wedges, toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper, and roast for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the sliced onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, cream, stock, lemon zest and peas and simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour the cream mixture over the potatoes. Season the salmon, place it on top and bake for 8–10 minutes, or grill briefly, until the salmon is just cooked.
Rest for 2 minutes and serve with the creamy potatoes.

title: Creamy tomato pork and mushroom spaghetti
steps: Finely chop onion and garlic and slice mushrooms.
Cook spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Heat oil in a large frying pan. Cook pork mince for 4–5 minutes, breaking it up until browned.
Add onion and mushrooms; cook for 3 minutes. Add garlic, tomato paste, and herbs; stir for 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in cream, then toss through spaghetti, adding pasta water as needed. Season and top with Parmesan.

title: Honey-mustard chicken with roast potatoes, peas and spinach
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Mix the honey, mustard, crushed garlic, lemon zest and juice, salt and pepper. Coat the chicken with half of the mixture.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and put them on a baking tray with the chicken. Toss the potatoes with the oil and roast for 35 minutes, turning the potatoes once.
Stir the remaining honey-mustard mixture through the tray. Add the peas and spinach for the final 3–4 minutes, until hot and wilted.
Rest the chicken for 2 minutes, then serve with the roast potatoes and greens.

title: Honey-mustard pork chops with roast potatoes and beans
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper, and roast for 10 minutes.
Mix the honey, mustard, crushed garlic, paprika and lemon juice. Coat the pork chops with the glaze.
Add the chops and beans to the tray. Roast for 15 minutes, then grill for 3–5 minutes until the glaze is browned and the pork is cooked through.
Rest the pork for 3 minutes and serve with the potatoes and beans.

title: Honey-mustard salmon with roast potatoes and broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Cut the potatoes into small chunks and boil for 8–10 minutes. Add the broccoli for the final 2 minutes, then drain.
Put the potatoes and broccoli in a roasting dish. Mix the honey, mustard and oil, then toss half through the vegetables.
Season the salmon with salt and pepper, place it on the tray and brush with the remaining glaze. Roast for 15–20 minutes, until the salmon flakes and the potatoes are browned.
Serve immediately with the tray juices.

title: Italian chicken, mushroom and zucchini pasta
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Slice zucchini and mushrooms and finely chop onion and garlic.
Boil pasta in salted water. Reserve 3/4 cup pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a large frying pan. Season chicken and cook for 5–6 minutes until browned and cooked through; transfer to a plate.
Cook onion, mushrooms, and zucchini in the same pan for 5–6 minutes until soft and lightly browned. Add garlic, tomato paste, and herbs for 30 seconds.
Return chicken to the pan with pasta, Parmesan, and 1/2 cup pasta water. Toss for 1–2 minutes, adding more water as needed for a glossy sauce. Season and serve.

title: Italian salmon and broccoli cream pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender; reserve 50 ml cooking water and drain.
Cook onion in oil until soft, then add peas, salmon, cream and water.
Cook 3–4 minutes until salmon flakes and is cooked through.
Stir through pasta with lemon and pepper and serve.

title: Italian sausage and broccoli cheesy pasta
steps: Boil pasta, adding broccoli for the final 4 minutes; drain.
Brown sausage meat with garlic and onion, then add cream and mustard.
Fold pasta, broccoli, Parmesan and half the cheese through the sauce.
Transfer to a dish, top with remaining cheese, and grill until golden.

title: Italian tofu and broccoli cheesy pasta
steps: Heat the oven grill to high. Boil pasta, adding broccoli for the final 4 minutes; drain.
Heat cream, mustard, Parmesan, half the cheese and a splash of pasta water until smooth.
Fold pasta and broccoli through sauce and transfer to an ovenproof dish.
Top with remaining cheese and grill 3–4 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Lemon chicken with potatoes and beans
steps: Cut potatoes into 2 cm cubes and boil for 12–15 minutes; add beans for the last 4 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, slice chicken and fry in oil for 6–8 minutes until cooked through.
Add minced garlic and herbs for 30 seconds. Stir in lemon juice and 2 tbsp water.
Toss in drained potatoes and beans; season and cook together for 2 minutes.

title: Lemon-oregano chicken traybake with potatoes and beans
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into small wedges and slice the onion. Toss them with half the oil, half the garlic, salt and pepper in a roasting dish. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken, remaining garlic, lemon zest and juice, herbs and stock. Drizzle with the remaining oil and roast for 20–25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are browned.
Steam or microwave the beans for 4–5 minutes, then stir them through the tray juices.
Rest the chicken for 2 minutes and serve with the potatoes and beans.

title: Lemon pork with potatoes and green beans
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Toss potatoes with oil, lemon, garlic, herbs, salt and water and roast 15 minutes.
Add the pork loin and green beans and roast until the protein is cooked and potatoes are tender.
Turn the protein once and spoon over the lemony pan juices.
Rest 2 minutes and serve hot.

title: Lentil, tomato and spinach stew
steps: Rinse lentils. Cook onion, carrot, garlic, cumin and paprika in oil until softened.
Add tomatoes, lentils and stock. Cover and simmer until lentils are tender.
Fold in spinach for the final 2 minutes and season with lemon, salt and pepper.
Serve as a thick stew with rice.

title: Mediterranean white fish with roast potatoes and capsicum
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Slice the potatoes thinly and cut the capsicum into strips. Toss them with 1 tbsp oil, herbs, salt and pepper and roast for 25 minutes.
Place the fish over the vegetables. Add the olives and lemon slices, drizzle with the remaining oil and roast for 8–10 minutes, until the fish flakes easily.
Remove the tray from the oven and rest the fish for 2 minutes.
Spoon the pan juices over the fish and vegetables before serving.

title: Mexican-inspired beef and corn rice
steps: Start rice and dice capsicum.
Brown beef in oil for 5–6 minutes.
Add capsicum and spices; cook for 3 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and corn.
Simmer for 8 minutes until beef is cooked and capsicum is tender. Serve over rice topped with cheese.

title: Mexican pork, corn and zucchini rice skillet
steps: Dice zucchini and capsicum and finely chop onion and garlic.
Start the measured dry rice in the rice cooker according to its instructions.
Heat a large frying pan with oil. Brown pork for 3–4 minutes, then add onion, zucchini, capsicum, and garlic; cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and spices for 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and corn, then simmer for 8–10 minutes until thick.
Top with cheese, cover for 1–2 minutes until melted, and serve over rice. All vegetables are cooked; no raw garnish is required.

title: Mexican-spiced white fish and corn rice skillet
steps: Start rice. Season fish with paprika, cumin, salt and pepper.
Sear fish in oil until just cooked and transfer out.
Cook onion, capsicum and garlic, then add tomatoes and corn and simmer until hot.
Return fish briefly to warm through; serve over rice with lemon.

title: Moroccan chicken and chickpea tomato tagine
steps: Start rice. Cook onion, garlic, cumin, paprika and cinnamon in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and brown the outside.
Stir in chickpeas, tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer until chicken is cooked and sauce thickens.
Taste and serve over rice.

title: Italian mushroom ragu pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender and reserve cooking water.
Brown mushrooms, onion and garlic in oil until deeply coloured.
Add tomatoes, stock and herbs and simmer until thick and savoury.
Toss through pasta, loosen with cooking water, and finish with Parmesan.

title: Mushroom and spinach jacket potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Prick the potatoes, rub with half the oil and bake for 70–75 minutes, until tender all the way through.
Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan. Cook the sliced mushrooms for 5–7 minutes until browned, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the spinach and cream and cook for 2–3 minutes until the spinach wilts. Season with the salt and pepper.
Split the potatoes, spoon in the mushroom mixture, top with cheese and return to the oven for 3–5 minutes to melt. Serve hot.

title: Beef stroganoff with mushrooms and mustard
steps: Start rice or boil potatoes. Cook the beef rump steak in oil until browned and cooked; transfer out.
Cook onion, garlic and mushrooms until soft.
Stir mustard, cream and stock into the pan and simmer until slightly thickened.
Return protein, warm through, and serve over rice or potatoes.

title: Creamy mustard chicken and mushrooms
steps: Cube potatoes and boil for 12–15 minutes. Add beans for the final 4 minutes.
Slice chicken and mushrooms. Fry chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes until cooked through.
Add mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes. Stir in mustard, cream and a splash of water.
Simmer for 2 minutes, season and serve with drained potatoes and beans.

title: Creamy mustard pork with mushrooms
steps: Start rice or boil potatoes. Cook the pork loin in oil until browned and cooked; transfer out.
Cook onion, garlic and mushrooms until soft.
Stir mustard, cream and stock into the pan and simmer until slightly thickened.
Return protein, warm through, and serve over rice or potatoes.

title: Paprika chicken with broccoli and potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes, capsicum and onion into small pieces and toss with half the oil, half the garlic, paprika, herbs, salt and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken rubbed with the remaining oil, garlic, lemon zest and juice. Roast for 30 minutes, turning the potatoes once.
Add the broccoli florets and pour the stock around the vegetables. Cover loosely with foil and roast for 10 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the broccoli is tender.
Rest for 2 minutes, then serve with the tray juices.

title: Pork chops with mustardy chickpeas and spinach
steps: Heat 0.5 tbsp oil in a large frying pan. Cook the sliced onion for 8–10 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the chickpeas and stock. Add the spinach and cook for 3 minutes until wilted. Mash about one-third of the chickpeas against the pan.
Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer for 3 minutes. Season with half the salt and pepper, then keep warm.

Season the pork with the remaining salt and pepper. Heat the remaining oil in a second pan and sear the chops for 6–7 minutes per side, until cooked through. Rest for 3 minutes and serve over the chickpeas.

title: Pork chops with roast potatoes and tomatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into thin wedges and boil for 6–8 minutes. Drain.
Layer the potatoes and sliced tomatoes in a roasting dish with the garlic, herbs, half the oil, salt and pepper. Bake for 15 minutes.
Rub the pork chops with the remaining oil and season. Set them over the potatoes and roast for 30–35 minutes, turning once, until cooked through.
Rest the chops for 3 minutes, then serve with the tomato potatoes.

title: Prawn fajitas with cooked capsicum and corn
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and wrap tortillas in foil to warm.
Mix paprika, cumin, garlic, oil and lime and coat the raw prawns with capsicum and onion.
Cook everything in a very hot pan until the protein is done and vegetables are charred and tender.
Serve hot filling in warm tortillas; omit raw salsa or salad.

title: Quick beef with paprika, peas and yoghurt
steps: Start rice or boil potatoes. Slice the protein and prepare peas.
Stir-fry the beef rump steak in oil until browned and cooked; transfer it out.
Bloom paprika and cumin in the pan, add stock and reduce by half.
Stir in peas and yoghurt, return protein, warm through, and serve.

title: Quick chicken with paprika, peas and yoghurt
steps: Start rice or boil potatoes. Slice the protein and prepare peas.
Stir-fry the boneless chicken thighs in oil until browned and cooked; transfer it out.
Bloom paprika and cumin in the pan, add stock and reduce by half.
Stir in peas and yoghurt, return protein, warm through, and serve.

title: Quick pork with paprika, peas and yoghurt
steps: Start rice or boil potatoes. Slice the protein and prepare peas.
Stir-fry the pork loin in oil until browned and cooked; transfer it out.
Bloom paprika and cumin in the pan, add stock and reduce by half.
Stir in peas and yoghurt, return protein, warm through, and serve.

title: Quick vegetable tomato pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender and reserve some cooking water.
Cook onion, garlic, carrot, zucchini and mushrooms in oil until softened.
Add vegetables and tomatoes with herbs and simmer until saucy.
Toss in pasta and spinach, loosening with cooking water; finish with Parmesan.

title: Rosemary-garlic chicken with roast potatoes and beans
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss them with half the oil, half the crushed garlic, lemon zest, salt and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken, remaining garlic, herbs, lemon juice and remaining oil. Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning the potatoes once, until the chicken is cooked through.
Steam or microwave the beans for 4–5 minutes while the chicken rests.
Serve the chicken and potatoes with the beans and spoon over the garlicky tray juices.

title: Blackened salmon fajitas with cooked corn
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and wrap tortillas in foil to warm.
Coat salmon with oil, paprika, cumin, chilli and lime.
Pan-fry salmon 3–4 minutes per side until blackened and just cooked; cook capsicum and corn in the same pan.
Flake salmon into warm tortillas with the cooked vegetables and serve with lime.

title: Creamy salmon and pea pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender; reserve 50 ml cooking water and drain.
Cook onion in oil until soft, then add peas, salmon, cream and water.
Cook 3–4 minutes until salmon flakes and is cooked through.
Stir through pasta with lemon and pepper and serve.

title: Quick sausage bolognese pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender.
Remove sausage meat from casings and cook in a frying pan with mushrooms until browned.
Add tomatoes and herbs and simmer until reduced.
Toss pasta through the sauce and finish with Parmesan.

title: Creamy sausage and mushroom pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender.
Remove sausage meat from casings and cook in a frying pan with mushrooms until browned.
Add tomatoes and herbs and simmer until reduced.
Toss pasta through the sauce and finish with Parmesan.

title: Sausage, roast potato and chickpea traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges and the onion into thick slices. Put them in a roasting dish with the sausages, tomatoes, lemon wedges, oil, herbs, salt and pepper.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning the potatoes and sausages once.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and stock. Roast for a further 15–20 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the sausages are cooked through.
Squeeze the roasted lemon over the tray and serve.

title: Smoky chickpea and eggplant tomato skillet
steps: Start rice. Brown eggplant in oil until softened.
Add onion, garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli and cook until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, chickpeas and water; cover and simmer until eggplant is tender.
Fold in spinach if using, taste, and serve over rice.

title: Smoky sausage with roast potatoes and capsicum
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes, capsicum and onion into bite-sized pieces. Mix the paprika, cumin, honey, tomato paste, chilli, oil, salt and pepper.
Toss the sausages and vegetables with the smoky coating in a roasting dish.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, turning everything once, until the potatoes are tender and the sausages are cooked through.
Rest for 2 minutes, then serve hot.

title: Smoky steak with Cajun potatoes and warm cabbage
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Boil the potatoes for 5 minutes, drain and steam-dry, then toss with the paprika, cumin, chilli, 1 tbsp oil, half the salt and half the pepper.
Spread the potatoes on a baking tray and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden.
Pat the steak dry and season with the remaining salt and pepper. Sear in a very hot frying pan for about 2–4 minutes per side, depending on thickness and preferred doneness. Rest for 5 minutes.
While the steak rests, heat the remaining oil in a frying pan. Cook the onion, cabbage and garlic for 5–7 minutes, adding a splash of water if needed, until soft and fully cooked.
Slice the steak and serve with the Cajun potatoes and warm cabbage.

title: Steak Diane with sauté potatoes
steps: Cut the potatoes into 2.5 cm chunks and simmer in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain and shake the colander gently to roughen the edges.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan. Fry the potatoes over medium heat for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, then add the garlic and herbs and cook for another 5 minutes until golden.

Season the steaks with the salt and half the pepper. Heat the remaining oil in a second pan, or move the potatoes to a covered plate, and sear the steaks for 2–3 minutes per side for medium-rare or longer to preference. Rest on a board.
Cook the onion in the steak pan for 2–3 minutes. Stir in the Worcestershire sauce, mustard and remaining pepper, then add the stock and reduce by about half.
Stir in the cream and simmer until the sauce lightly coats a spoon. Slice the steaks and serve with the sauce and sauté potatoes.

title: Garlic-herb steak with roast potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp oil, half the salt and pepper, and roast for 25–30 minutes until crisp.
Stir together the garlic, herbs, balsamic vinegar, juice of the lemon half, chilli flakes and 0.5 tbsp oil. Set the sharp herb dressing aside.
Rub the steaks with the remaining oil and season with the remaining salt and pepper. Sear in a very hot pan for 3–4 minutes per side, or to preference, then rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the steaks across the grain and spoon the garlic-herb dressing over them. Serve with the roast potatoes.

title: Rump steak with pan potatoes and peas
steps: Cut the potatoes into 2 cm chunks and boil for 8–10 minutes until just tender. Drain and leave to steam-dry.
Mix the garlic, balsamic vinegar, 0.5 tbsp of the oil and half the pepper. Coat the steaks and leave them while the potatoes cook.
Heat a large frying pan until very hot. Sear the steaks for about 3–4 minutes per side, or to the preferred doneness, then transfer to a board to rest.
Add the remaining oil and potatoes to the steak pan. Fry until browned, then add the peas and 2 tbsp water for 2 minutes. Season with the salt and remaining pepper.
Slice the rested steaks and serve with the browned potatoes and peas.

title: Steak with peppercorn mushroom cream and roast potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into small wedges, toss with 0.75 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt, and roast for 25–30 minutes until golden.
Season the steaks with half the pepper and salt. Heat a large frying pan until very hot, add 0.5 tbsp oil and sear the steaks for 2–4 minutes per side. Transfer to a board to rest.
Add the remaining oil to the pan. Cook the onion and mushrooms for 5 minutes until browned, then add the garlic and remaining pepper for 30 seconds.
Pour in the stock and reduce for 3–4 minutes. Stir in the cream and simmer for 2 minutes until lightly thickened.
Slice the rested steaks and spoon the mushroom-pepper cream over them. Serve with the roast potatoes.

title: Italian steak pizzaiola with potatoes
steps: Cut the potatoes into 2 cm pieces and boil for 10–12 minutes until tender. Drain and keep covered.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy frying pan with the garlic. Season the steaks and sear them briefly on both sides, working in batches if needed.
Return the steaks to the pan, add the canned tomatoes, Italian herbs, salt and pepper, and partially cover. Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes, turning the steaks once, until cooked to preference.
Transfer the steaks to a clean board and rest. Increase the heat and reduce the tomato sauce for about 5 minutes.
Slice the steak and spoon over the pizzaiola sauce. Serve with the potatoes.

title: Tofu fajitas with cooked capsicum and onion
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and wrap tortillas in foil to warm.
Mix paprika, cumin, garlic, oil and lime and coat the firm tofu with capsicum and onion.
Cook everything in a very hot pan until the protein is done and vegetables are charred and tender.
Serve hot filling in warm tortillas; omit raw salsa or salad.

title: Oven-baked white fish and chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into chips, toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper, and spread on a tray. Roast for 30 minutes, turning once.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the lemon zest, herbs and remaining oil. Put the fish in a small baking dish, season, and press the crumb mixture on top.
Add the halved tomatoes to the chip tray and put the fish in the oven for the final 10–12 minutes, until the crumb is golden and the fish flakes.
Serve with the roast tomatoes, chips and lemon wedges.
